ns2:section.sectionText: Meets twice a week for the first 8 weeks of the Fall 2008 semester. Permission of instructor(s) required to enroll. The Tuesday class meetings will be will held in Room 341 LISB (east end, inside the ISRL suite); the Thursday class meetings will be held in the Soybean Press facility at the Facilities & Services Printing Department (249 Printing Building, 54 E. Gregory Drive, Champaign). A $35 non-waived fee for class materials (fee is not for a "field trip" as stated below) will be assessed to student's tuition & fees bill. [Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections.]
